guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
Dockerfile build fails during the installation of Python 3.11 and related packages on Ubuntu 20.04. Error messages: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11", "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv", "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils". This is because Ubuntu 20.04 default repositories do not provide Python 3.11 packages. To fix this, add the deadsnakes PPA repository before installing Python 3.11 and its components. Specifically, add the line 'add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa' before the apt-get update and install commands. This ensures Python 3.11 packages are available for installation. Adjust the Dockerfile as follows: 

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y software-properties-common && \
    add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3.11 python3.11-venv python3.11-distutils python3-pip ... (other dependencies) \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

This fix is necessary to successfully install Python 3.11 and related tools in the container.
